usDebtPromo.leadIn: While you wait, try the tools we built.
usDebtPromo.title: Our U.S. Debt
usDebtPromo.text: See the U.S. national debt day by day, from public U.S. Treasury data that is updated each business day and goes back to 1993. Pick any dates to get a chart, stats and the numbers behind them, plus a trend line that looks ahead. You can also compare how the debt changed during each presidential term.
usDebtPromo.linkText: Try Our U.S. Debt at bengusa.pro/ourusdebt →

image.alt: A screenshot of the Our U.S. Debt tool: a line chart of the U.S. national debt over time, in trillions of dollars, with a red trend line that looks ahead.

languageBasicsPromo.title: Language Basics
languageBasicsPromo.text: Flashcards for your first words in Albanian, Spanish, Japanese and Bengali: numbers, letters, and everyday words and phrases. Read the card, say it out loud, then see the answer and how to say it. It runs in your browser, with no sign-up.
